# ✅ Good — always exits 0, output still shows any matches
grep -rn '/ 100' server/src/api/ || true

async function generateQuoteNumber(): Promise<string> {
  const updateResult = await db
    .update(sequences)
    .set({ currentValue: sql`${sequences.currentValue} + 1` })
    .where(eq(sequences.name, 'quote'))

  if (updateResult.changes === 0) {
    // Sequence doesn't exist yet — create it starting at 1
    await db.insert(sequences).values({ name: 'quote', currentValue: 1 })

  const [seqRow] = await db
    .select({ currentValue: sequences.currentValue })
    .from(sequences)
    .where(eq(sequences.name, 'quote'))

  const seqNum = seqRow!.currentValue
  return `QT-${String(seqNum).padStart(4, '0')}`

export async function createQuoteLineItem(quoteId: string, input: CreateQuoteLineItemServiceInput): Promise<QuoteLineItem> {
  // Enforce draft status on parent quote
  await enforceDraftStatus(quoteId)

  const now = Date.now()

  // Fetch VAT rate to calculate tax amounts
  const vatRate = await getVatRate(input.vatRateId)

  // Calculate line totals (discount in basis points: 100 = 1%, 10000 = 100%)
  const discountMultiplier = input.discountPercent != null ? 1 - input.discountPercent / 10000 : 1
  const lineTotalNet = Math.round(input.unitPriceNet * input.quantity * discountMultiplier)
  const lineTotalVat = Math.round(lineTotalNet * vatRate.rate / 10000)

  const lineItemId = crypto.randomUUID()

  // Use raw SQL for insert to avoid Drizzle ORM issues with spread columns
  const client = sqliteDb as Database.Database
  
  client.prepare(
    'INSERT INTO quote_line_items (id, quote_id, line_type, part_id, labor_service_id, description, quantity, unit_price_net, vat_rate_id, discount_percent, line_total_net, line_total_vat, line_total_gross, bicycle_id, bicycle_brand, bicycle_model, bicycle_year, bicycle_color, bicycle_frame_size, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
  ).run(
    lineItemId,
    quoteId,
    input.lineType,
    input.partId ?? null,
    input.laborServiceId ?? null,
    input.description,
    input.quantity,
    input.unitPriceNet,
    input.vatRateId,
    input.discountPercent !== undefined ? input.discountPercent : null,
    lineTotalNet,
    lineTotalVat,
    lineTotalGross,
    input.bicycleId ?? null,
    input.bicycleBrand ?? null,
    input.bicycleModel ?? null,
    input.bicycleYear ?? null,
    input.bicycleColor ?? null,
    input.bicycleFrameSize ?? null,
    now
  )

  const [inserted] = await db.select().from(quoteLineItems).where(eq(quoteLineItems.id, lineItemId))

  return {
    ...inserted,
    createdAt: inserted.createdAt.getTime(),
  } as QuoteLineItem

export async function updateQuoteLineItem(quoteId: string, lineItemId: string, input: UpdateQuoteLineItemServiceInput): Promise<QuoteLineItem> {

  const effDiscountPercent = input.discountPercent !== undefined ? (input.discountPercent != null ? input.discountPercent : null) : existing.discountPercent
  const effVatRateId = input.vatRateId ?? existing.vatRateId

  // Fetch VAT rate for recalculation

  // Recalculate totals based on effective values

  const lineTotalNet = Math.round(effUnitPriceNet * effQuantity * discountMultiplier)
  const lineTotalVat = Math.round(lineTotalNet * vatRate.rate / 10000)

  const params: unknown[] = []

    setClauses.push('description = ?')
    params.push(input.description)

  if (input.quantity !== undefined) {

    params.push(input.quantity)

    params.push(input.unitPriceNet)

    params.push(input.vatRateId)
  }
  if (input.discountPercent !== undefined) {
    setClauses.push('discount_percent = ?')
    params.push(input.discountPercent != null ? input.discountPercent : null)
  }

  // Always update totals (no updated_at column on quote_line_items)
  setClauses.push('line_total_net = ?', 'line_total_vat = ?', 'line_total_gross = ?')
  params.push(lineTotalNet, lineTotalVat, lineTotalGross)

  // Type-specific fields (always update if provided)
  if (input.partId !== undefined) {
    setClauses.push('part_id = ?')
    params.push(input.partId ?? null)
  }
  if (input.laborServiceId !== undefined) {
    setClauses.push('labor_service_id = ?')
    params.push(input.laborServiceId ?? null)
  }
  if (input.bicycleId !== undefined) {
    setClauses.push('bicycle_id = ?')
    params.push(input.bicycleId ?? null)
  }
  if (input.bicycleBrand !== undefined) {
    setClauses.push('bicycle_brand = ?')
    params.push(input.bicycleBrand ?? null)
  }
  if (input.bicycleModel !== undefined) {
    setClauses.push('bicycle_model = ?')
    params.push(input.bicycleModel ?? null)
  }
  if (input.bicycleYear !== undefined) {
    setClauses.push('bicycle_year = ?')
    params.push(input.bicycleYear ?? null)
  }
  if (input.bicycleColor !== undefined) {
    setClauses.push('bicycle_color = ?')
    params.push(input.bicycleColor ?? null)
  }
  if (input.bicycleFrameSize !== undefined) {
    setClauses.push('bicycle_frame_size = ?')
    params.push(input.bicycleFrameSize ?? null)
  }

  // Use raw SQL for update to avoid Drizzle ORM issues with spread columns
  const client = sqliteDb as Database.Database

  if (setClauses.length === 0) {
    // No fields to update — just return the existing item
    const [existingItem] = await db.select().from(quoteLineItems).where(eq(quoteLineItems.id, lineItemId))
    return { ...existingItem, createdAt: existingItem.createdAt.getTime() } as QuoteLineItem
  }

  client.prepare(
    `UPDATE quote_line_items SET ${setClauses.join(', ')} WHERE id = ?`
  ).run(...params, lineItemId)

  const [updated] = await db.select().from(quoteLineItems).where(eq(quoteLineItems.id, lineItemId))

  return {
    ...updated,
    createdAt: updated.createdAt.getTime(),
  } as QuoteLineItem
}

async function generateQuoteNumber(): Promise<string> {
  const updateResult = await db
    .update(sequences)

    .where(eq(sequences.name, 'quote'))

  if (updateResult.changes === 0) {

    await db.insert(sequences).values({ name: 'quote', currentValue: 1 })

    .select({ currentValue: sequences.currentValue })
